title: UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection
abstract: arXiv:2610.39385v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $\pi_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/

translated_title: UMI-Live：面向真实野外环境的双手机器人数据采集系统
translated_abstract: 通用操作接口（UMI）设备使人类专家能够为机器人学习演示任务，而无需远程操控实体机器人。然而，将这些演示用作训练数据仍然需要一致的硬件设置、校准和数据处理。我们提出了UMI-Live，一个用于真实野外数据采集的全栈开源双手UMI系统。我们设计了定制的UMI-Live硬件，集成了相机与激光雷达-惯性传感、机载计算和电源，无需外部追踪设备，也无需在采集环境中进行校准。我们实现了一个简单的用户界面用于记录数据，同时由异步流水线执行并行SLAM重建，并发布可直接用于训练的数据集。我们还发布了支持双YAM遥操作以及VLA策略训练与推理的软件。我们通过微调 $\pi_{0.5}$ 和 MolmoAct2 验证了UMI-Live的数据质量，分别达到了10/10和8/...的成功率（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: UMI-Live是一个全栈开源的双手UMI系统，无需外部追踪设备或环境校准即可在真实野外环境中采集双手机器人演示数据，并通过异步SLAM流水线直接生成可用于VLA策略训练的数据集。
en_tdlr: UMI-Live is a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system that enables in-the-wild robotics data collection without external tracking or calibration, using an asynchronous SLAM pipeline to directly produce training-ready datasets for VLA policies.
